# smallstep_browser (Data Source)

Configuration to use a credential for browser mTLS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smallstep_browser" "my_mtls" {
  id = "47cb6412-9509-49e4-bda5-a3758499d3f9"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of this protected browser configuration.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Set of String) The UUID of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this browser integration.
- `match_addresses` (List of String) List of URLs the configuration applies to.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this configuration.
